heroTagline: Discover Your True Colors & Frame Perfect Glasses
heroSparkSubtitle: AI-Powered Personal Color & Face Shape Diagnostics
heroIntro: Upload a natural portrait to unlock your Seasonal Color Archetype, formulate a personalized Cosmetics Blueprint, select bespoke Glass Frame geometries, and drape real virtual palettes.
featuresSubtitle: Harness precision computer vision & expert chroma calculations to perfect your personal branding.
varnaDockSub: Tap on seasonal ranges to preview organic warm/cool palettes crafted to complement unique physical features.
feat1Desc: Determines your matching color group—Spring, Summer, Autumn, or Winter—based on skin, eye, and contrast readings.
feat2Desc: Calculates facial coordinates to categorize your profile into one of 6 universal frame geometries instantly.
feat3Desc: Provides tailored frame recommendation styles with sizing & shapes configured perfectly for your face contour.
feat4Desc: Formulates your custom makeup colors instantly: details your perfect lipstick shades, blush highlights, and eyeshadow tones mapped to your season.
feat5Desc: Saves your past scans and matching palettes securely on your device. Easily compare seasonal ranges or recall your colors anytime.
feat6Desc: Creates high-fidelity 9:16 portrait graphics optimized for social stories, showcasing your personal color archetype and frame shape.
uploaderSub: Position your face under even, natural lighting without makeup, glasses, or strong shadows for optimal accuracy.
cameraAccessError: Could not access camera. Please check camera permissions or select a gallery photo.
dragInactiveText: Drag & drop your portrait here, or click to browse
fileLimitsText: Supports high-resolution JPG or PNG. Face must be looking straight ahead under natural light.
uploaderAlert: Note: Portrait photos are processed entirely server-side using Gemini 2.0 and resized for security; no raw image files are permanently stored.
historyEmptySub: Upload and analyze your photo to log your first seasonal diagnostic!
historyDeleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to permanently delete this saved color analysis? This action cannot be undone.
drapeInteractiveText: Slide across different custom swatches to see how your facial portrait responds under relative color temperatures.
samplePhotoDesc: Perfect: Front angle, clean skin, natural daylight
cleanSkinDesc: Heavy foundations or vibrant cosmetics shift natural facial and contour reads. Keep skin fresh.
clearFacialMarginsDesc: Avoid bangs, hats, excessive hair, or bulky accessories masking cheekbones, jaw, and forehead contours.
naturalDaylightDesc: Avoid artificial bulbs, fluorescent tubes, or multi-directional room lighting that skew chromatic levels.
straightAngleDesc: Look directly toward the camera without smiling widely to prevent contour skewing.
howToGrab: How to Grab the Best Picture
photoGuidelineSub: Please follow these precise physical setup criteria so our visual algorithms map your tones and frame structure with maximum precision.
tasteOfScienceSub: Personal color mapping guides selection not just in wardrobe, but in hair dyes, facial highlights, and eye accessories to balance natural skin pigmentation and minimize fine lines.
uncoverChemistryQuery: Ready to uncover your true aesthetic chemistry?
uncoverChemistrySub: Join thousands of design-focused individuals refining their frames and personal cosmetics color maps.
